answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with decay: each agent locks a deposit tied to its registered address, and honest work slowly grows its weight while inactivity erodes it. Like shale layers, reputation builds slowly and cannot be faked overnight; a karst of hollow shell accounts collapses under verification because empty identities earn nothing; and a sudden plume of new accounts triggers a review that freezes their weight until they prove real work. Cloning stops paying because the cost is real and the reward is slow.
